executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
Waterstone Resort & Marina appeared in at least one AI answer for 70.5% of the traveler needs we tested, showing that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stays. Across every individual AI answer, however, Waterstone Resort & Marina appeared 48.7% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see Waterstone Resort & Marina in the hotel options surfaced.

Couples / Romantic Stay is Waterstone Resort & Marina's clearest competitive strength. The hotel appeared in 61.1% of AI answers for these searches, compared with 11.5% for the comparable hotels used in this analysis — about 5.3 times as often as the comparable hotels used in this analysis. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Waterstone Resort & Marina appeared in the Top 3 44.8% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.
